I’m Kashif Merchant, a product leader working across agentic applications and platforms. I build teams from the ground up and bring product, engineering, and operations together around real work.

A capable model gives us more options. Product judgment is choosing which ones are worth using. These projects explore that choice through useful tools, inspectable decisions, and clear human handoffs.

Product approach

Judgment is part of the product.

Start with the decision.

Define the outcome, the person accountable for it, and the evidence they need to make a useful choice.

Make uncertainty visible.

Show what the system observed, what it inferred, and what still needs a person’s judgment.

Verify the outcome.

Check the resulting state. Keep explanations connected to evidence, and make failure cases easy to inspect.
